entities.summary: Denis Valeryevich Sergeyev is a Russian professional ice hockey forward. He is currently playing for HC Neftekhimik Nizhnekamsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He had previously played for Vityaz Chekhov of the KHL.
